name: inserted records have independent copied fields and start at version one
input: one draft record followed by caller and view mutations
test:
db = VersionedRecordDatabase()
fields = {'state': 'draft', 'priority': 2}
db.insert('m1', fields)
fields['state'] = 'tampered'
assert db.get('m1') == {'id': 'm1', 'version': 1, 'fields': {'state': 'draft', 'priority': 2}}
view = db.get('m1')
view['fields']['priority'] = 99
assert db.get('m1')['fields']['priority'] == 2

name: patches update and remove fields atomically with a matching version
input: a version-one record with one replacement one addition and one removal
test:
db = VersionedRecordDatabase()
db.insert('m1', {'state': 'draft', 'owner': 'ada', 'priority': 2})
assert db.patch('m1', 1, {'state': 'ready', 'retries': 0}, remove=['owner']) == 2
assert db.get('m1') == {'id': 'm1', 'version': 2, 'fields': {'state': 'ready', 'priority': 2, 'retries': 0}}
assert db.find('state', 'ready') == [{'id': 'm1', 'version': 2, 'fields': {'state': 'ready', 'priority': 2, 'retries': 0}}]
